title: Contact
metaDescription: Find St John's Park, send a message, ask about life events, and access practical travel and safeguarding information.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: Whether you are planning a first visit, asking about church life, or getting in touch about a specific need, we would love to hear from you.

image.alt: The church building and grounds at St John's Park

sections.title: Location
sections.body: Hyde Park tram stop is right next to the church, and we have limited on-site parking with nearby overflow parking available when needed.
points: Limited on-site parking from Bernard Street
Overflow parking nearby via Maltravers Road and St John's Street

image.alt: People gathered around the church grounds

sections.title: Life Events
sections.contentHtml:
If you want to ask about baptisms, weddings, or funerals, please use the contact form below or email us directly.

You can also begin with these links: Life events information and Celebrating new birth.

sections.title: Safeguarding
sections.body: Safeguarding has its own dedicated page so you can find policy details, key contacts, and diocesan support quickly.
